name: PlainHealth
subtitle: Your Health, Explained Simply
shortDescription: Understand your health in plain English. Lab results, medications, conditions — explained simply. Works offline; ads removable with a one-time purchase.
longDescription:
PlainHealth is your personal health education companion that explains medical information in plain, everyday language — so you can actually understand what your
  doctor is telling you.

88% of adults have difficulty understanding health information. After a doctor visit, most patients forget 40-80% of what was discussed. PlainHealth bridges that
  gap.

WHAT YOU GET — FREE:

- Lab Results Explained: 24 common tests (cholesterol, A1C, thyroid, kidney, liver, and more) with what they measure, what high/low means, and how to improve
  - Medications Guide: 24 drugs with uses, side effects, food interactions, and warnings in plain English
  - Conditions Library: 22 health conditions with symptoms, causes, prevention, and questions to ask your doctor
  - Ask: Health Q&A chat with instant answers to common questions
  - Medical Glossary: 50+ terms defined without jargon
  - Health Numbers: Color-coded reference for blood pressure, cholesterol, blood sugar, BMI, and more
  - Emergency Guide: Heart attack signs, stroke FAST protocol, when to call 911
  - First Aid: 10 step-by-step guides (CPR, choking, burns, bleeding, seizures)
  - Wellness Guides: Exercise, mental health, nutrition, sleep, hydration, aging, vaccinations

PREMIUM FEATURES ($4.99 one-time):

- Health Tracker: Track blood pressure, weight, blood sugar, heart rate, and more over time
  - Health Calculators: BMI, heart rate zones, water intake, calorie calculator
  - My Medications: Personal medication list
  - Interaction Checker: Check drug-drug interactions offline
  - Symptom Guide: Find related health topics by symptom
  - Pre-Visit Prep: Tailored questions for 8 doctor visit types
  - Family Health History: Track hereditary conditions
  - Nutrition & Sleep Guides
whatsNew: Adds ads served by Google AdMob. Remove them any time with the new one-time Remove Ads purchase (Settings). Bug fixes and improvements.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
